claim: The prototype first asks a model to propose a schema for unfamiliar content.
The generated schema is passed back with the content so the model returns filled structured data.
The speakers propose using the schema to generate a React component for displaying the extracted data.
Schema generation is described as an iterative loop that can regenerate or refine the shape.
The episode implementation uses a Python and FastAPI backend with BAML and a React frontend.
note: Architecture is also stated in the source README.
